(4) Section - A: Attempt all questions. (5) Section - B : Attempt all questions. (6) Section - A (01 - 20) contains 20 multiple choice questions which have only one correct answer. Each question carries +4 marks for correct answer and -1 mark for wrong answer. (7) Section - B (21 - 25) contains 5 Numerical value based questions. The answer to each question should be rounded off to the nearest integer. Each question carries +4 marks for correct answer and -1 mark for wrong answer.
